parties.petitioner: M/s. Shekhar Resorts Limited (Unit Hotel Orient Taj)

summary: Moratorium under IBC vs Sabka Vishwas Scheme deadline; inability to pay due to statutory prohibition during insolvency proceedings; Designated Committee's existence beyond scheme deadline; manual processing permitted post-deadline per CBEC instructions; precedence of IBC over inconsistent statutes; legal disability as force majeure; remedy not barred due to operation of law; escrow payment compliance.
legal_provisions_cited: Sunil Vasudeva vs. Sundar Gupta (2019) 17 SCC 385
United Air Travel Services vs. Union of India (2018) 8 SCC 141
Union of India vs. Asish Agarwak (2022) SCC Online SC 543
Gyanichand vs. State of Andhra Pradesh (2016) 15 SCC 164
Calcutta Iron Merchants Association vs. Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (1997) 8 SCC 42
Anmol Kumar Tiwari & Ors. vs. State of Jharkhand (2021) 5 SCC 424
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; respondents directed to appropriate payment of Rs. 1,24,28,500 under Sabka Vishwas Scheme; discharge certificate to be issued.
